name: Enchanted Wilds
notes: Set-level parameters as of 18.1. Later changes live in patches/<patch>.json. Shop odds and pool sizes are read from the game files (CommunityDragon 16.20 = 18.4; the 18.1-18.4 notes list no change to them). Nothing is 'verified' until checked in-game or stated by an official source.

shop_odds.source: game file map22.bin.json (CommunityDragon 16.20), TFTSet18 DropRateTables.Shop, matches seemeta; level 7 row from the in-game shop tooltip (owner screenshot, 18.4b); levels 8 and 9 also seen in game
shop_odds.note: Percent per cost tier 1..5 by player level. Game file stores fractions (0.19 ...). Not in any 18.x patch note, so assumed unchanged since 18.1. Level 7: the in-game tooltip shows 16/30/43/10/1, while the game file and the official 17.1 notes say 19/30/40/10/1. The tooltip is what the live game shows, so it is used; whether actual rolls follow it is not proven (it would take a large shop count).

conflicts.note: Game file (only shop table in map22, no 16/30/43 table present) and the 17.1 notes ('Level 7: 16/30/43/10/1% => 19/30/40/10/1%'). The 18.1 Set 18 launch notes mention no odds. The in-game tooltip on 18.4b disagrees.

copies_per_champion.source: game file map22.bin.json (CommunityDragon 16.20), TFTSet18 ShopContentData TierBags Count; matches seemeta

champions_per_cost.source: game file map22.bin.json TierBags (units per tier bag); same counts in the CommunityDragon champion list and tactics.tools
champions_per_cost.note: Lux is in the 5-cost bag once (DA_Lux18_Base); its forms are not separate pool entries.

shop_slots.source: long-standing TFT shop size; not checked for Set 18
shop_slots.note: Champion slots in a shop without a Wisp. See shop_rules.wisp_slot.

reroll_cost.source: seen in game by the owner on 18.4b

xp_purchase.source: in game on 18.4b: Buy XP button costs 4 gold (owner screenshot) and gives 4 XP (owner)

passive_xp_per_round.source: seen in game by the owner: 2 XP every round (reported 2026-10-18, checked again on 18.4b 2026-10-20)

xp_to_next_level.source: levels 7-9 from the 18.2 notes' old values (60, 68, 68); levels 1-6 from third-party tables
xp_to_next_level.note: Key = current level, value = XP needed to reach the next level. 1->2 is automatic. 18.2 changes 7->8 to 56 (see patches).

max_level.note: shop_odds lists level 11; it may only be reachable with an augment.

base_income.source: op.gg gold-xp guide and wiki TFT:Gold
base_income.note: Gold paid at the start of each round, before interest, streak and win gold. 5 from 2-2 on. The owner's stage 4 income readings (owner-ingame-2026-10-20) fit 5; the early-stage values are not checked.

interest_per_10_gold.source: op.gg gold-xp guide and wiki TFT:Gold; seen in game: 20 gold gave 2 interest (owner, 18.4b)

interest_cap.source: op.gg gold-xp guide and wiki TFT:Gold

streak_gold.source: op.gg gold-xp guide (Set 18) and tft.ninja; streaks of 4, 5 and 6 checked in game (owner, 18.4b)
streak_gold.note: [[min streak length, bonus gold]]: 2-4 -> +1, 5 -> +2, 6+ -> +3. Same for win and loss streaks. In game at stage 4 (income = 5 base + interest + streak): 4 win streak +1, 5 +2, 6 +3, matching this table and ruling out tables with 4 -> +2. Not yet seen: whether a 2 streak pays (the wiki conflict below), loss streaks.

conflicts.note: Wiki income section starts at 3; looks like the 14.1 rule that was later reverted.

pvp_win_gold.source: op.gg gold-xp guide, wiki TFT:Gold and tft.ninja
pvp_win_gold.note: Paid when the player combat is won, before interest is computed.

sell_value.source: wiki TFT:Gold rule: a unit sells for what it cost (cost x copies) when it is 1-star or 1-cost, otherwise 1 gold less
sell_value.note: Key = cost, list = gold for 1/2/3-star. Derived from the rule, not read from the game. The wiki's own example (3-star 1-cost sells for 5) contradicts the rule; check 2-star and 3-star values in game.

player_damage.source: op.gg gold-xp guide and tft.ninja (stage damage plus 1 per surviving enemy unit, regardless of star level)
player_damage.note: Damage a player takes after losing a player combat. Research also saw 0/2/5/7/9/11/17/150 (attributed to the 14.8 notes, URL not found) and 2/6/7/10/12/17 (tftflow, page not recorded); neither could be sourced well enough to record as a conflict.

wisp_slot.source: Riot patch 18.1 notes ('Wisps appear in every other shop') https://teamfighttactics.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/game-updates/teamfight-tactics-patch-18-1 ; rightmost slot: https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/TFT:Enchanted_Wilds ; 4 champions + Wisp: https://noxutft.com/guide/wisps , https://blitz.gg/tr/tft/articles/tft-set-18-wisps-guide
wisp_slot.note: When a Wisp is shown, the shop has 4 champions. Claim (unverified): a 5th champion is hidden behind the Wisp and appears if the Wisp is bought or when the round starts. For roll-downs the slot is treated as lost. On by default for Set 18.

inferno_upgrade.source: Inferno trait: shop slots roll one cost tier higher (esports.gg Set 18 overview); exact rule unknown

riftbeast_shop.source: Riftbeast (5): next shop overrun with Riftbeasts every few combats (esports.gg Set 18 overview); exact rule unknown

bad_luck_protection.source: parameter block seen in Set 11 game files (ACIK_KAYNAK_INCELEME.md 2.5); the TFTSet18 entry in map22.bin.json 16.20 has no field named for it, but some of its fields are hashed, so this is not proof of absence
